name: How long does drywall patching usually take?
description: Tiny repairs can be quick, but larger patches usually take 1–2 days because each coat needs time to dry.

mainEntity.name: How long does drywall patching usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small repairs can often be finished the same day, but compound drying time usually pushes larger patches into a 1–2 day project or longer if multiple coats are needed. In Denver-area homes, cooler indoor conditions or humidity from leaks can slow drying.
